name: Campaign for Tobacco-Free Kids
summary: Campaigns for tobacco-control laws: taxes, smoke-free places, warnings, advertising and flavour bans. In the US it works at federal, state and local level; abroad it funds and advises campaigners and governments in ten priority countries and in Africa, as a lead partner of the Bloomberg Initiative to Reduce Tobacco Use. Its Global Health Advocacy Incubator runs similar campaigns on food, road safety and other health policy.
